name: Boots of Speed

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Click the heels
powers.text: Bonus Action: double your Speed, and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage. 10 minutes of use per Long Rest.

summary: Click your heels (Bonus Action): doubled Speed and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage, 10 minutes a day.
text: Click the heels together as a Bonus Action to double your Speed; while this lasts, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage. Clicking them again ends the effect. After a total of 10 minutes of use, the boots go dormant and stay that way until you complete a Long Rest.
